description: UDP flows: the shared MCP server's asynchronous tools send a DNS-format query over a connected UDP socket (udp) or a DNS query with dnspython's asynchronous client (dns) to an exclusive port answered by a DNS-format responder. Manual binding (markers at start and end) versus automatic binding with fact_rt's datagram hooks. Collector fact-udp.bt (fact.bt plus the first datagram per socket and destination as a flow).
